notes.title: Resident Block Update
notes.content:
Dear players,

I have updated the resident block sprite so that it will show it's current population and quality of life level. 

If a block population is below 9, or if it's not powered or without jobs, smog stains will appear. 

If population is between 9 and 10, the block will show clean, as it always did. 

And if the population is over 10, nice little plants will appear on the balconies meaning that block can upgrade to a Mega Block. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25673821/a8667326be227701fcd7f4e8ea90b8853daf6b58.png


I also increased the trees effect, so that you won't need so many of them for blocks to rise over 10 residents.

Finally, a quick fix on "Power to the people" mission, now you will not lose if a power plant falls off the screen. 


Hope you enjoy these changes! 

Have fun!

Fernando

ps. If you have a vote to spare for BalanCity at IndieDB's Top 100 Indies of 2016, please support the game at:

www.indiedb.com/games/balancity

Thanks!

notes.title: New Advisors! - October Update
notes.content:
October Update - New Advisors, a couple of shortcuts and fixes

Hey! It's been a while since the last update but today you will see a couple of new things in the game. 

Choose your advisor

Now you will be able to pick your favorite advisor to assist while you build our city! 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25673821/44bb19a9f0858f9d6ce4f4b4989fe91d5e518158.png

Apart from SUP, now you can play with Don, Peppy and Heelaree. 

Each one has his own power up for your city, Don makes the military more effective, Heelaree makes emergency helicopters faster and Peppy, he just wants to play with you and make unhappy feelings go away. 

Scroll and Zoom with the keyboard

Now you can pan your city view using the directional keys in your keyboard, as well as  ,  and .  to zoom in and out. 

Autosave

Now the game autosaves Free Build and Scenarios every 10 seconds. Everytime you leave your city, it will be saved so that you can continue building it some other time or if the game crashes. Beware that you cannot leave the game without saving, so it is kind of permadeath of your city if you lost. 



There have been numerous bug fixes and balance tweaks to the game. Please report any bugs you may encounter. 

Have fun! 

Fernando

notes.title: 9/16 Update! Linux support and a special achievement!
notes.content:
Hey!

If you happen to own Linux, now you can play BalanCity on it! It should work on any Linux 64bit operating system and was tested on Ubuntu. 

In other news, there is a new achievement named "Matreon", it will be unlocked to anyone who plays the game during Early Access before launch next week. 

After release, the achievement will be removed from the game so it is an ephemeral token, just to see how many people will unlock it. 

Working on leaderboards right now, hope to have a Top 10 Builders list by launch!

Fernando

notes.title: 9/8 Pre Release Update
notes.content:
Hey! A new update is available, what's new?


 Added Credis screen (unlockable after beating Free Mode or via the settings menu.
 Added random scenario "World Tour" unlockable after beating all scenarios.
 Added language support, Spanish and English available now, more will be added in the future (if you wish to help translating to other languages, let me know!)
 Final OST by Ariel Contreras Esquivel from Ostrich Studios!



This is the last BIG update before release next week. So please, report any bug, big or small, in order to polish the game. There is a known bug in "Topsy Turvy" mission, couldn't get around to fix it in this update, but it will be fixed ASAP!

Thanks for your support! 

Fernando

notes.title: 8/24 update!
notes.content:
Hey! It's been a while but I have been working hard to complete the game. Today's release includes new missions and game configurations. I have also implemented a progression system, so you may see a couple of features locked (don't worry, you can unlock the whole game in the Settings Menu!)

Here's what has been updated:


 New missions! The whole mission pack has been completed. 
 Added extra settings to configure Free Build Mode starting conditions such as platform type, gravity strength and a "shantytown" mode.
 Added progression system and unlockables. 
 Added "Unlock all" and "Reset" buttons to settings menu. 
 Added a couple of new music tracks to the scenarios.
 Added Windows 64bit build of the game and updated the Mac OSX version (Linux version comes next!)
 


The game will be released in a couple of weeks, so feedback and bug reporting is vital at this stage. Hope you enjoy this update and would love to see more gameplay videos! 

See you in the next update!

Fernando

notes.title: 8/10 Quick Monster fix
notes.content:
Hey guys!

There was a really annoying bug that made monsters invincible. Now it has been (should be) fixed! 

Here is the list of changes in today's update:

• Fixed immortal monster bug
• When building Power Plants and Offices, you will see an "influence halo" around the block to preview the block's effect radius.
• Added new music to some scenarios and a couple of extra sound effects. 

Remember that you can access a "test" mission by pressing "m" on the main menu.


Don't forget to send feedback and bug reports!

notes.title: 8/2 update!
notes.content:
Hey! 

The game has been updated with a couple of tweaks to disaster spawn rates. I've seen many people having trouble with monsters or meteors suddenly destroying their precious work, so I reduced the number of disasters you will face in the first minutes of gameplay.

There is also a new settings screen in the intro menu. From there you will be able to switch between full screen and windowed mode (does not seem to work properly the first time you click, gotta check on that), mute sound and set the disaster spawn ratio for every type of disaster. Let me know how this work for you and if you think the settings need a little bit of tweaking.

In an upcoming update I will add missions and more tutorial that will cover the things that the regular tutorial does not. For example, mega blocks and skyscrapers.

Don't forget to keep posting feedback! 

See you in the next update!

notes.title: Friday update! 7/29
notes.content:
Hey! 

A quick update (7/29) to a couple of major bugs and a bit of new content added. 


 Added London scenario, play in the fog!
 Added Quit Button to Intro screen (no more task manager)
 Removed rogue Facebook link that opened when returning from scenarios.
 Changed Back to Menu icon to something that did not resemble "replay".

 Extra hidden feature: Pressing "m" on the intro menu takes you to a secret level that consists on a mission to plant power plants in a premade city. This mission mechanic is being worked on so expect bugs and crazyness, but it is there for you to try, if you wish.  



Thanks to all the players who gave input in the current version of the game, keep that feedback coming!


Edit: Forgot to tweak the monsters HP, now it takes 100 missiles to kill. It should take a little less. I leave this for the next update.
